description: Phase 14 direct-distribution QPU microcampaign on ibm_kingston. This extends the paper-quality affine scaling line from n=5, 32 midpoint cells, to n=6, 64 midpoint cells.
rationale: gr_affine_n6 passed the Phase 14 backend-aware audit on ibm_kingston.
The selected opt=2, seed=34567 candidate had depth 361, 103 two-qubit gates, predicted noisy TVD 0.046682, and maximum noisy quantity-of-interest error 0.014242.
This is the direct continuation of the Phase 9 gr_affine_n5 scaling result from 32 to 64 midpoint cells.
The campaign measures only the direct Grover-Rudolph distribution; amplified QAE remains deferred after Phase 13.

selected_cases.label: affine positive law, 64 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Direct algebraic-integration scaling candidate at n=6.

stopping_rules: Submit only after confirming the dry-run depth and two-qubit count match the Phase 14 backend-aware audit.
Promote as a Phase 14 direct-distribution scaling result only if TVD stays below 0.06 and max cell deviation stays below 0.025.
Use quantity-specific errors for all integration claims.
Do not attach Grover amplification in this campaign.
